rno.jpg.giveaway: Reads as real. Frosting is irregular and hand-spread, with crumbs and lumps along the rim and soft buttercream highlights. The lettering is piped unevenly in thick red-orange icing. The candles are a mixed set (plain yellow, red/white spiral, white), lean at slightly different angles and are pushed in to different depths. Flames are small, overexposed white cores with a faint warm halo and no stylised teardrop shape. Video compression blocking and a soft, low-contrast black with a faint grey band at the top edge. Shallow focus falls off on the lower cake wall. Only a flat, sourceless dark surround keeps it from a 10.

azm.jpg.giveaway: Reads as real. Lumpy hand-spread frosting with a visible ridge and dents, decorations sunk into the icing rather than sitting on top, and a candle cluster that is uneven in height and spacing, with soft overlapping flames and a faint smoke haze. The table is a dim, blurry square that falls into murky shadow, with mild haze and macroblocking in the dark areas. The light is uneven and warm, coming from the flames and a soft top source, with no hard CG shadow edge.

xnr.jpg.giveaway: Rendering. The frosting top uses a uniform procedural bump/noise texture (the same fine stipple everywhere) with a perfectly elliptical rim and an evenly scalloped piped border, both too regular. The lettering is extruded 3D blobs sitting on the surface, not piped icing. The candles are clean cylinders with perfect helical stripes and identical tapered flame sprites; two candles have no flame contact with the wick, and the blue/white candle is a palette the other frames never show. The thin wisps above the flames are straight vertical lines, not smoke. The side wall is flat with sparse black dots placed like decals. The background is a smooth noiseless gradient, the black level is too clean, and there is no lens falloff or grain.

zve.jpg.giveaway: Rendering, same model as xnr. The frosting top has a uniform micro-bump with perfect concentric shading, and the piped bottom border is a regular sine-wave scallop. The candles are geometrically straight cylinders with identical flame sprites, one floats near the lettering with no visible base, and the lettering is a too-clean 3D extrusion. The dots on the side are sparse and decal-flat. There is no grain or compression texture: the dark background is a smooth noise-free gradient with a faint grid-like dither. The light falloff on the cake wall is too even, with no flame-driven flicker or hotspots.

fhs.jpg.giveaway: Rendering. Every candle is unlit: white tips with no flame, which contradicts the scene. One candle lies flat on the frosting like a dropped stick. The frosting top shows concentric procedural ring banding (a wood-grain look). The black dots on the side are perfectly round, glossy and evenly sized, like stickers. The side wall is a smooth orange-yellow gradient with a waxy subsurface look. The framing crops the cake hard against the right edge, with a large empty dark area left and a big soft circular falloff that reads as a CG spotlight, not a room.

vhs.jpg.giveaway: Rendering, sibling of fhs. Same concentric ring banding on the top, same perfectly round glossy decal dots, same flat red lettering bar placed like a tag. The flames are tiny, uniform white teardrops sitting on the candle tips with no glow, so the cake gets no light from them. The key light is a single CG spot, with a crisp-edged cast shadow of the cake falling on the left. The candles are spaced too evenly, and one sits alone on the rim in a way that looks placed. There is no grain.

nkh.jpg.giveaway: Rendering. The cake is a perfect cylinder seen dead-on at eye level, with a mathematically regular scalloped base on a flat board. The side wall has a uniform fine noise texture and a few black dots clustered like decals. The candles are seven identical-height sticks with the same flame sprite, and the straight vertical wisps above them are lines, not smoke. The table is a flat plane with a hard horizontal front edge and a dark band beneath, like a stage. The pool of light under the cake is a clean radial gradient. Colour is a flat, desaturated tan with no warm flame contribution on the frosting top, and there is no grain.

vit.jpg.giveaway: Rendering, same scene as nkh. Front-on perfect cylinder, regular scalloped base plate, decal dots, identical candles (only six visible flames) with vertical line wisps, and a flat red lettering blob on the top edge. The table has a hard front edge and a black band below, with a symmetric radial light pool. The side texture is a uniform noise pattern, the colour is flat salmon-tan, and there is no grain or compression texture.

rhy.jpg.giveaway: Rendering. The cake is a smooth, plastic-looking cylinder with a soft subsurface orange glow and no frosting texture at all. The candles are cropped by the top frame edge, so the flames are mostly out of frame; they are thin pink/white sticks of uniform shape. The decal dots are sparse. The table fills two-thirds of the frame as an empty, smooth, noiseless surface with a CG area-light falloff and an oval contact shadow. The composition puts the subject in the top third with nothing to look at below.

llp.jpg.giveaway: Rendering, sibling of rhy. A smooth waxy cylinder with an orange subsurface look and even, round decal dots. The candles are cut off at the top of the frame, with one overexposed sprite flame in the middle. The large empty table plane is noise-free, with a soft oval shadow ring. The cake looks miniature, like a product shot, with no frosting relief, no crumbs and no lettering legible. There is no grain or haze, and the black level is clean.
